# 7.17 Lot amalgamation at Riverstone Town Centre

**(1)**
This clause applies to development for the following purposes on land identified as "Riverstone Town Centre" on the *Lot Amalgamation Map*—
- (a) boarding houses,
- (b) community facilities,
- (c) hotel or motel accommodation,
- (d) places of public worship,
- (e) residential flat buildings,
- (f) seniors housing,
- (g) serviced apartments,
- (h) multi dwelling housing,
- (i) mixed use development if—
  - (i) the development comprises both commercial premises and residential accommodation, and
  - (ii) the residential component of the development is not for the erection of a single dwelling house.

**(2)**
The objectives of this clause are the following—
- (a) to encourage site amalgamation for the purposes of flood evacuation, including the provision of safe evacuation routes,
- (b) to deliver community facilities, public spaces and large format retail.

**(3)**
Development consent must not be granted to development to which this clause applies unless the consent authority is satisfied that the lot on which the development will be carried out will be amalgamated with certain other lots identified on the *Lot Amalgamation Map*.
